subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways support the separate opt-in that lets verified Tailscale identity and tailnet ACLs participate in gateway authentication?
rationale: The implementation now avoids general operator delegation and preserves existing authentication by default, but accepting another authorization authority is a permanent product security contract that code review cannot approve implicitly.

options.title: Approve explicit identity trust
options.body: Accept the separate opt-in with root-owned Tailscale administration, layered device authentication, clear authority disclosure, and current-head recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Keep transport only
options.body: Land private Serve connectivity but remove or defer gateway.auth.allowTailscale so all users continue to require existing token and device authentication.

options.title: Pause core integration
options.body: Defer the feature until the long-term Tailscale authorization and support boundary has a separately documented design.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit identity trust
recommendation.body: Accept the separate opt-in with root-owned Tailscale administration, layered device authentication, clear authority disclosure, and current-head recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete available routing signal is the detailed security-boundary review that defined the accepted least-privilege alternatives and remaining product choice.
